paragraphs: This is This Week in Congress, from Power to the People, for the week ending Saturday, October 10th, 2026.
This briefing is read by a computer voice. Every fact in it comes from public records at Congress.gov, the House Clerk and Senate.gov.
The Senate held no recorded votes this week.
The House held no recorded votes this week.
Two bills became law: the Improving Social Security’s Service to Victims of Identity Theft Act and the Billion Dollar Boondoggle Act of 2025.
Coming up, the Senate next meets Tuesday, October 13th, 2026. The plan: convene for a pro forma session at 3:30 p.m. The House has not posted a floor schedule.
That's this week in Congress. You can read every bill and every vote in the app. Thanks for listening.
voice: Norman (Piper text to speech, public domain)
